entry.title: Unitree’s Shanghai IPO 5,526 Times Subscribed by Retail Buyers
entry.summary: The highly anticipated initial public offering of Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, drew huge demand from retail investors as China’s leading humanoid robot maker opened books in Shanghai.

entry.title: JPMorgan Strategists Raise S&P 500 Target as AI Capex Pays Off
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists raised their S&P 500 Index forecast for a second time in two months, citing strong corporate earnings and the payoff from massive artificial intelligence spending.

entry.title: Rakuten Earns First Profit in Six Years Due to E-Commerce Jump
entry.summary: Rakuten Group Inc. earned its first net income in six years thanks to surging growth in its e-commerce and fintech segments, with help from the company’s chatbot.

entry.title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
entry.summary: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.

entry.title: JPMorgan Boosts Tech Bond Sales Outlook as AI Debt Binge Expands
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. sees bond sales from technology-related firms exceeding half a trillion dollars this year, as hyperscalers’ appetite to deploy capital for the artificial intelligence buildout shows no sign of abating despite growing investor fatigue.
